text:
amelia: Hey all — quick heads up: our next all-hands is Tue Oct 12 @ 11am PT (calendar invite sent). Agenda: 1) Exec update, 2) Product demo (Optimize features + Dedicated rollouts), 3) Policy update (data retention), 4) Hiring & org changes, 5) 2-min lightning demos, 6) Q&A + feedback. Please drop questions below or add to the doc: https://tiny.redwood/ah-oct12. TL;DR: we’ll record and post the clip. 🙏

sanjay: Can we get a short bullet for the policy change so teams can prep? trying to coordinate with support.

amelia: Yep — Maria will post a short summary this afternoon and we'll include in the prep doc.

maria: Draft is up: https://tiny.redwood/policy-draft — summary: default retention moves from 30→90 days for logs; customer data controls unchanged. Will need legal sign-off.

derek: Heads up — we'll call out Dedicated capacity SLA improvements in the exec update. Want a one-slide stat on latency gains.

olivia: I'll prepare the slide; can I grab recent bench numbers from eng-sre? @derek any preferred chart?

derek: latency p50/p95 before vs after quantization is perfect. keep to 1 slide.

amelia: Lightning demo signups: please DM me your title + 2 bullets by Fri EOD if you want a slot. We'll pick 4 demos.

maria: Adding note: if your demo touches customer data, add privacy checklist to the doc. (cc: @security-bot)

security-bot: Reminder: attach the minimal dataset and redaction notes for any demo using PII. See playbook: https://tiny.redwood/sec-playbook

brandon: Will there be a live incident recap segment? want to summarise last week's infra blip (brief RCA + mitigation).

amelia: Yes — 5 min recap + action items. @eng-sre please prepare 2 bullet actions.

sanjay: Can we record separate clips for the product demo so PMs can reuse in customer comms?

amelia: Good idea — we'll capture the segment clip and upload to the playbook folder after editing.

all-hands-bot: Recording started: https://meet.redwood/recordings/ah-1745556666

lina: Quick ask — childcare stipend question raised in PeopleOps; can we include a one-slide HR update?

amelia: Added to agenda (HR update). Thanks Lina.

maria: Legal sign-off ETA: Mon, Oct 11. If delayed we’ll call out “pending approval” in the all-hands.

derek: Small ops ask — can presenters upload slides by Mon noon so we can build the show deck?

amelia: Will do a final agenda + meeting notes post on Mon afternoon with links. Thanks everyone. :sparkles:
